description: This file contains utility functions for converting and validating Mattermost interactive dialog elements, transforming server responses, and handling form data for dialogs within the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: validateDialogElement
methods.description: Validates individual dialog elements, logs warnings in enhanced mode, and returns validation errors.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Determines the AppField type based on the dialog element type and data source.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Computes the default value for a dialog element based on its default property and type.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the options array for select/radio dialog elements.

methods.name: convertElement
methods.description: Converts a DialogElement into an AppField object, performing validation and adding type-specific properties.

methods.name: transformServerDialogToProps
methods.description: Transforms server response format (snake_case) into dialog props format (camelCase).

methods.name: convertDialogToAppForm
methods.description: Converts dialog elements and metadata into an AppForm object, performing validation and handling source configuration.

methods.name: extractPrimitiveValues
methods.description: Extracts primitive values from form data, converting select options to their values and filtering out empty or null values.

methods.name: convertServerDialogResponseToAppForm
methods.description: Transforms a server dialog response directly into an AppForm, combining response transformation and dialog conversion.

methods.name: convertAppFormValuesToDialogSubmission
methods.description: Converts form values back into a dialog submission format, validating options and data types.
